name: Anil Advani
tagline: Top rated Business & Corporate attorney in San Francisco, California
about: Anil Advani is a top-rated attorney practicing in the San Francisco, California area. Providing legal representation in California for a variety of different issues, Anil Advani was selected to Super Lawyers for 2021 - 2026.
After completing undergraduate studies, Anil Advani attended law school. Anil Advani was admitted to the practice of law in 1996.

Attorneys like Anil Advani are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Anil Advani represents clients with Business / Corporate issues. Additional legal issues represented include Intellectual Property, International, Mergers & Acquisitions and Technology Transactions.
